sources.entry: Nominatim - Server application for geocoding (address -> coordinates) and reverse geocoding (coordinates -> address) on OpenStreetMap data. (Source Code) GPL-2.0 C

summary.one_liner: Nominatim is a server application that geocodes addresses and place names to coordinates and reverse-geocodes coordinates to addresses, using OpenStreetMap data.
summary.what_it_does: Nominatim searches OpenStreetMap data by name and address (forward geocoding) and generates synthetic addresses for OSM points (reverse geocoding). The README describes it as a tool that powers one of the sources for the search box on the OpenStreetMap home page. Installation is done by cloning the repository, installing the bundled nominatim-api and nominatim-db Python packages into a virtualenv, creating a project directory, importing an OSM extract with the nominatim import command, and serving results through a webserver started with nominatim serve. Documentation for the development version lives in the docs/ subdirectory, with stable-release docs and a troubleshooting/FAQ hosted separately. The Lua configuration files for osm2pgsql are included in the repository.
use_cases: reverse geocode GPS coordinates to addresses
run a private place-name search service
provide search box backend for a map
how_to_run: wget the country_osm_grid.sql.gz file into Nominatim/data/
notable: Provides both forward geocoding and reverse geocoding on OpenStreetMap data
Used as a source for the search box on the OpenStreetMap home page
Installed as separate nominatim-api and nominatim-db Python packages
Includes Lua configuration files for osm2pgsql under Apache 2.0
Has a built-in nominatim serve command for running a webserver
caveats: Requires importing OSM data into a project directory before it can answer queries
Requires downloading a separate country grid data file during setup
Webserver setup needs extra packages (uvicorn, falcon) installed separately
Stack-level platform requirements are not detailed in the README beyond the steps above
